```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path
# to your clone (the directory containing shared-R).
REPO_ROOT <- "/path/to/repo"
REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Pantranscriptome/Analyze_F1_RPVG_data_exploration/"))
set.seed(0)

require("ggplot2")
require("cowplot")
require("viridis")
require("reshape2")
require("dplyr")
require("tidyverse")
library(plotly)
library(Rtsne)
library(stringr)
library(ggbeeswarm)

library(DSS)

source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

library(data.table)
```

```{r read ASE}
fread("DESeq2_ASE_results.txt") -> ASE
```

```{r read ASA}
fread("mm10_ASE_aca.bed") -> ASA
colnames(ASA) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "Transcript", "score", "strand", "peak_chr", "peak_start", "peak_end", "peak_strand", "HOMER_Annotation", "HOMER_Annotation_detailed","unknown","unknown2")
```

```{r subset for ASE data}
subset(ASE, Transcript_cluster %in% ASA$Transcript) -> ASE_subset_in_ASA

print(paste("There are", nrow(ASE_subset_in_ASA), "ASE results that have a corresponding ASA result."))
print(paste("There are", nrow(ASE), "ASE results in total."))

print(paste("There are ", nrow(ASA), "ASA results in total."))
```

```{r plot volcano, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
# plot the log2FoldChange of ASE_subset_in_ASA vs padj
ggplot(ASE_subset_in_ASA, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(stroke=0, size=1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "log2FoldChange", y = "-log10(padj)") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  theme_cowplot()

```

```{r plot histogram of log2FoldChange for significant ASE_subset_in_ASA, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
ggplot(subset(ASE_subset_in_ASA, padj < 0.05), aes(x=log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "grey", color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "log2FoldChange", y = "Count") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

ggplot(subset(ASE, padj < 0.05), aes(x=log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "grey", color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "log2FoldChange", y = "Count") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

```

```{r get significant ASA_subset_in_DESeq}
subset(ASE_subset_in_ASA, padj<0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange)>0.5) -> ASE_significant_in_ASA
subset( ASA, Transcript %in% ASE_significant_in_ASA$Transcript_cluster ) -> ASA_subset_in_DESeq_significant

ASA_subset_in_DESeq_significant$Transcript %>% unique()
```

```{r}
fread("Founders-pantranscriptome-info.tsv") -> pantranscriptome_info

subset(pantranscriptome_info, Transcripts %in% ASA_subset_in_DESeq_significant$Transcript) -> pantranscriptome_info_significant

ASE_significant_in_ASA$Transcript_cluster %>% unique() -> GOI


INDEX <- 5
subset(ASA_subset_in_DESeq_significant, Transcript==GOI[INDEX])$Transcript
subset(ASA_subset_in_DESeq_significant, Transcript==GOI[INDEX])

subset(ASE_significant_in_ASA, Transcript_cluster==GOI[INDEX])

subset(pantranscriptome_info_significant, Transcripts==GOI[INDEX])

```

```{r compare to eQTL data}
fread("ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table.tsv") -> ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table

print(paste("There are", nrow(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table), "genes that show both significant ASE and ASA."))

# Calculate the Spearman correlation between the Delta and Delta_coef columns without subsetting for haplotype match
print("Correlation between Delta and Delta_coef for all genes:")
cor.test(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table$Delta,ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table$Delta_coef, method="spearman")

print(paste("There are", nrow(subset(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table, Haplotype_Match=="Yes")), "genes that show both significant ASE and ASA and have a haplotype match."))
# Calculate the Spearman correlation between the Delta and Delta_coef columns for genes with a haplotype match
print("Correlation between Delta and Delta_coef for genes with a haplotype match:")
cor.test(subset(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table, Haplotype_Match=="Yes")$Delta,subset(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table, Haplotype_Match=="Yes")$Delta_coef, method="spearman")

# How many are not Multiple_isoforms
print(paste("There are", nrow(subset(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table, Haplotype_Match=="Yes" & Multiple_isoforms=="No")), "genes that show both significant ASE and ASA, have a haplotype match, and do not have multiple isoforms."))

# Calculate the Spearman correlation between the Delta and Delta_coef columns for genes with a haplotype match and no multiple isoforms
print("Correlation between Delta and Delta_coef for genes with a haplotype match and no multiple isoforms:")
cor.test(subset(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table, Haplotype_Match=="Yes" & Multiple_isoforms=="No")$Delta,subset(ASA_ASE_eQTL_Table, Haplotype_Match=="Yes" & Multiple_isoforms=="No")$Delta_coef, method="spearman")
```
